main.description: A chat message, written into the author's own repo in a Parlor space.

text.description: Message text. May be empty when an attachment is present.

attachment.description: One file attached to a message. Images are shown inline; PDFs are offered as downloads.

name.description: Original file name, for display and download.

thumb.description: Images only: a smaller copy shown in the chat; the full file opens on request.

width.description: Images only: width in pixels, as displayed.

height.description: Images only: height in pixels, as displayed.
